journeys.name: Book settings: appointment types, daily quota and open hours
journeys.objective: The branch sets how long a visit takes, how many patients a consultant or unit sees a day, and when they are open.
journeys.preconditions: Clerk on BR-A. DR-1, DR-2 and UNIT-1 exist. No book settings yet.

1. Opens Appointments and clicks "Book settings"
2. Clicks "Add type" twice and fills "QA Konsultasi" 30 and "QA Kontrol" 15
3. Clicks "Add quota", chooses Consultant, DR-1 and 3; adds Unit, UNIT-1 and 2
4. Clicks "Add hours" for each open-hours row of the shared data and sets weekday, from and to
5. Clicks "Save settings"
